triples.subject: Alyosha
triples.quote: Alyosha gave his evidence modestly and with restraint, but his warm sympathy for his unhappy brother was unmistakable.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: I was led to do so by my brother Dmitri’s words.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: repaying Katerina Ivanovna half (half, note!) what he owed her, he yet could not bring himself to repay the money

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: Katerina Ivanovna replied firmly that she had been formerly betrothed to the prisoner, “until he left me of his own accord...”

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: he repelled with indignation the suggestion that his brother might have committed a murder for the sake of gain

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: I made no accusation against Smerdyakov of myself.” “Yet you gave evidence against him?” “I was led to do so by my brother Dmitri’s words.

triples.subject: Dmitri
triples.quote: Mitya confirmed it, saying that he had been pointing to the fifteen hundred roubles which were on his breast, just below the neck

triples.subject: Dmitri

triples.subject: Fyodor Pavlovitch
triples.quote: I knew he had a feud with his father and have always believed that he had been unfairly treated by his father.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: I knew he had a feud with his father and have always believed that he had been unfairly treated by his father.

triples.subject: Dmitri Fyodorovitch Karamazov
triples.quote: He felt quite certain that he would receive the money from his father, and spoke to me several times about it. I knew he had a feud with his father

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: I was once indebted to him for assistance in money for more than three thousand, and I took it

triples.subject: Smerdyakov
triples.quote: The lackey, Smerdyakov, who murdered his master and hanged himself last night.

triples.subject: Rakitin
triples.quote: Why, he is my cousin. His mother was my mother’s sister.

triples.subject: Samsonov
triples.quote: He was my benefactor; he took me when I hadn’t a shoe to my foot, when my family had turned me out.

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: The woman who came between us has ruined him; she is the cause of it all, let me tell you

triples.subject: Katerina Ivanovna
triples.quote: as she finished giving her evidence and sat down again in the court, at a good distance from Katerina Ivanovna.

triples.subject: Mitya
triples.quote: Mitya was silent throughout her evidence. He sat as though turned to stone, with his eyes fixed on the ground.

triples.subject: Ivan
triples.quote: Ivan was called to give evidence.
